review_candidates.title: ACER COE – Postdoctoral Researcher in Membrane and Electrode Technologies
review_candidates.description: ACER COE – Postdoctoral Researcher in Membrane and Electrode Technologies for Battery and Fuel-Cell System About UM6P Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) is an internationally oriented institution of higher learning, that is committed to an educational system based on the highest standards of teaching and research in fields related to the sustainable economic development of Morocco and Africa. UM6P is an institution oriented towards applied research and innovation. On a specific focus on Africa, UM6P aims to position these fields as the forefront and become a university of international standing. More than just a traditional academic institution, UM6P is a platform for experimentation and a pool of opportunities, for students, professors and staff. It offers a high-quality living and study environment thanks to its state-of-the-art infrastructure. With an innovative approach, UM6P places research and innovation at the heart of its educational project as a driving force of a business model. In its research approach, the UM6P promotes transdisciplinary, entrepreneurship spirit and collaboration with external institutions for developing up to date science and at continent level in order to address real challenges. All our programs run as start-ups and can be self-organized when they reach a critical mass. Thus, academic liberty is promoted as far as funding is developed by research teams. The research programs are integrated from long-term research to short-term applications in linkage with incubation and start-up ecosystems. About ACER CoE The Centre was established to address enduring process challenges in Chemistry and Engineering disciplines and create an environment for interdisciplinary research. The research program of ACER CoE is multidisciplinary, with faculty members from backgrounds in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Environmental Engineering focusing on different research fields such as catalysis, separation, energy generation, conversion and storage, and organic optoelectronics intelligent and advanced polymers and materials. Job Description A postdoctoral position is currently available in the field of Membrane and Electrode Technologies for Battery and Fuel-Cell Systems. The aim of this position is to advance scientific research and development of high-performance specific membranes for different applications (Catalytic materials and electrodes for fuel cell applications; Polymer electrolyte for Lithium-ion Batteries). The main objective of this position is to develop and synthesize suitable membranes, optimize their integration and shaping into functional electrodes or electrolyte, and finally evaluate their performance through fuel cell and battery testing. The Candidate Will Be Involved In Conducting original scientific research in the field of Membranes, Polymers for Batteries and fuel cells. Characterizing the developed membranes using appropriate physicochemical, structural, morphological, and electrochemical techniques. Investigating the integration of polymer electrolyte membranes with catalytic electrodes to develop and optimize membrane–electrode assemblies. review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 一、工作职责 1. 全流程项目交付管理：统筹半导体集成项目从产品到货、安装调试至最终验收的全生命周期，保障项目按期、按质、按预算落地。 2. 计划与资源统筹：牵头编制项目实施计划、核算工程量、调配内外部资源，制定交付进度表，施工队、软件研发及供应商跨职能团队完成现场实施工作。 3. 多维度管控：严格监控项目范围、成本、进度、质量与安全，确保执行标准符合半导体/面板厂洁净室规范及客户KPI要求。 4. 客户对接与变更管理：作为客户核心接口人，承接需求变更，快速响应技术问题，组织根因分析（RCA）并推动整改闭环，提升客户满意度。 5. 风险防控：建立技术、供应链、界面、环境等维度的项目风险清单，制定应急预案，提前规避或降低执行风险。 6. 外部干系人协同：负责外包施工队、第三方检测机构的合同履约管理、技术交底及进度质量管控，保障各环节界面无缝衔接。 7. 技术方案与设计支持：主导项目相关CAD设计的审核与优化，牵头编制、评审技术方案，确保设计及方案满足项目技术指标与现场实施要求。 8.下单与到货验收：负责项目物料的申购单下单，负责物料到货的质量验收及物料出入库管理工作。 9.成本控制与回款：按照部门KPI成本控制指标，做好项目成本控制。配合市场部完成项目回款。 二、任职要求 1. 项目经验：5年以上项目经理从业经验，具备千万级项目独立管理经验者优先。 2. 行业经验：拥有无尘室、气体侦测、大气站施工经验者优先。 3. 综合能力：具备优秀的跨部门沟通、客户谈判及抗压能力，可在多任务、多界面、多文化环境中高效推进项目。 4. 资质认证：持有机电/通信/市政方向建造师证书；熟悉GMP、SEMI S6、FM/UL等安全认证体系者优先。 5. 技术能力：熟练使用CAD软件进行图纸绘制、审核，具备独立编制、优化半导体集成类项目技术方案的能力，可指导现场技术实施。
